meta.title: Add force_mode_constant parameter to bypass psutil overhead
meta.body_summary: Add force_mode_constant parameter to EmissionsTracker to bypass psutil overhead and use constant CPU power estimation, addressing 10x slowdown in short ML training iterations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added force_mode_constant to bypass psutil; maintainer approved but raised precedence concern with force_mode_cpu_load, PR remains open.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 212 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, mostly in a new test file (147 lines). The PR remains open, awaiting a minor design clarification on parameter precedence.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer inimaz questioned the behavior when both force_mode_constant and force_mode_cpu_load are True; benoit-cty agreed that force_mode_constant should take precedence and noted it needs handling.
review_details.performance_claim: Force constant mode eliminates psutil overhead causing 10x slowdown in short ML training iterations (11s vs 1m55s).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent added a new parameter to bypass psutil but missed the interaction with existing force_mode_cpu_load parameter; maintainer review identified the need for explicit precedence logic.

detection_detail.code_reading: inimaz performed static review questioning parameter precedence; benoit-cty confirmed need for precedence handling.
detection_detail.load_test: benoit-cty manually tested with CODECARBON_FORCE_MODE_CONSTANT=True and confirmed elimination of overhead.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body cites real-world timing case (11s vs 1m55s); maintainer successfully reproduced with monitor command.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Precedence issue raised by review; maintainer acknowledged but no fix committed yet in this open PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added force_mode_constant parameter to EmissionsTracker, made psutil imports conditional in cpu.py and util.py, updated resource_tracker.py to prioritize constant mode, and added tests and docs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file covers new mode; docs additions are minor.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding parameter, graceful imports, resource tracker logic, tests, and docs.

review_signals.summary: Questioned behavior when force_mode_constant and force_mode_cpu_load are both True.
review_signals.action_taken: benoit-cty acknowledged and noted need for precedence; no fix yet.
